wiki.title: Kevin Harris (politician)
wiki.extract: Kevin M. Harris (born October 24, 1981) is an American politician who is a member of the Maryland Senate representing the 27th district since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as a member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 27A from 2023 to 2025.
